FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions


Find answers to common questions by clicking below.

Do I need a business license in Kittitas?

If you have a business or are planning to do business within the city limits of Kittitas for profit or gain, you are required to obtain a business license and renew it annually. This includes, but is not limited to shops and home based businesses. A business license is easily obtainable for a nominal fee by visiting City Hall. See Title 5 - Business Licenses and Regulations of the Kittitas Municipal Code.

How do I connect or disconnect utilities?

Electrical Service is handled by either:
Puget Sound Energy (PSE). Their customer service number is 1-888-225-5773.
Or
PUD. Their phone number is (509) 933-7200.

Water & Sewer hookups and disconnects can only be performed Mon - Thur between 8am - 6pm (Closed Friday), and must be handled in person at City Hall.

How can I pay my Water/Sewer bill?

Online - by clicking the Online Bill Pay box at the top of this site or visiting Official Payments website.

In person - at City Hall - We accept cash, check, money order or credit card*. (A fee will apply for credit card transactions)

By Drop Box - located directly outside the front door of City Hall.

Am I required to license my dog?

Yes. The City requires proof of current rabies vaccinations and that dogs be licensed annually. Additional information regarding dogs and other animals can be found under Title 6 - Animals of the Kittitas Municipal Code.
